description: This file defines an abstract class 'NormalizableDTO' in the namespace 'OrangeHRM\Core\Report\DisplayField'. It provides methods for normalizing arrays of data and abstract methods for converting objects to arrays and providing a mapping of fields to getter methods. It is likely used as a base class for Data Transfer Objects (DTOs) within the reporting feature of the OrangeHRM system.

classes.name: NormalizableDTO
classes.description: An abstract class serving as a base for data transfer objects that can be normalized into array form for reporting purposes.

methods.name: toArray
methods.description: Abstract method meant to convert the DTO to an array representation based on specified fields.

methods.name: getFieldGetterMap
methods.description: Abstract method that should return a mapping of field names to getter method sequences.

methods.name: normalizeArray
methods.description: Normalizes an iterable dataset into a structured array grouped by fields, using getters specified in getFieldGetterMap.

methods.name: callGetterOnItem
methods.description: Invokes getter methods on a data item, supporting chained method calls if getter is an array.
